name: detect_vn_legacy_text
author: hprebar
title: Find pre-Unicode Vietnamese text (TCVN3 / VNI)
description: Read-only. Shows what convert_vn_text_encoding would do with the same arguments: the text an old Vietnamese drawing holds in a legacy encoding — TCVN3/ABC (.VnTime, .VnArial, .VnTimeH capitals-only fonts, uv-abc.shx) or VNI-Win (VNI-Times, VNI-Avo, VNI-Helve…, vn_vni.shx) — with a Unicode preview of each, the legacy styles that would switch to a Unicode face, the ones that would be kept, and the entities that would fail (LAYER_LOCKED / LAYER_FROZEN / CELL_LOCKED) or refuse the call (NO_FONT_MAPPING). The charset comes from the font in force: the style's, or an inline \f font inside MText (Symbol runs, e.g. f = φ, and runs in Unicode fonts such as Arial are never touched). Looks at DBText, MText, attributes, attribute definitions (value + prompt), dimension text overrides, multileaders and table cells, in model space, every layout and (includeBlocks) every block definition — never xrefs, nor the *D / *T blocks AutoCAD regenerates; text with a field, multiline attributes and entities already converted (XData HP_VNCONVERT) are skipped. The rule that keeps the screen readable: with remapStyles (default) a legacy style is switched to its Unicode face only when every legacy text under it is converted in the same run — when some stay (outside the selection, in an excluded block or table, on a locked layer, carrying a field) the style is kept and its selected texts are held too. Filter with handles (an INSERT's handle selects its attributes) and/or layers (wildcards); no filter = the whole drawing. sourceCharset tcvn3 | vni forces a charset on text whose font the rules do not know (VNI bytes left under an Arial style) and needs a handles / layers filter; auto (default) never guesses. fontMap {"<legacy face or SHX file, wildcards ok>": "<Unicode TrueType face>"} chooses the face a legacy font becomes (every SHX font and VNI-* faces other than Times/Helve/Avo/Arial need one). Returns the analysis envelope {success (false when NO_FONT_MAPPING would refuse), summary {examined, convert, held, failed, byType, inBlockDefinitions, stylesRemapped[{name, font, charset, upperCaseOnly, targetFace}], stylesKept, unicodeStyles, skipped, sourceCharset}, items[{handle, type, owner (layout or block name), inBlockDefinition, layer, style, fields, field, text, preview}] (the texts to convert, first changed value, 80 characters each), count, offset, truncated, warnings, errors}; page with limit (max 40) and offset.

handles.description: Only these entities (an INSERT selects its attributes); empty = all

layers.description: Only entities on these layers (AutoCAD wildcards); empty = all

includeBlocks.description: Also look inside block definitions (title blocks, symbols); xrefs and *D/*T blocks never

sourceCharset.description: auto: only text in fonts the rules know as legacy; tcvn3 / vni: also text in unknown fonts

fontMap.description: Legacy face or SHX file (wildcards) → Unicode TrueType face, e.g. {"VNI-Univer": "Arial", "vn_vni.shx": "Arial"}

remapStyles.description: Plan as convert_vn_text_encoding would with the same value
